title: Elite Dangerous screenshot folder location
desc: Set this to the location where Elite Dangerous stores its screenshots, if you want to display or convert screenshots in EDCoPilot

title: Display new screenshots
desc: Enable this to display a screenshot when you take one

title: Converted screenshot folder location
desc: Click to see or change where EDCoPilot will store converted screenshots if options to convert are enabled

title: Convert standard screenshot
desc: Converts your new screenshot. If combined with 'Zero out orignal' option this will help save disk space

title: JPG quality level for standard screenshots
desc: Set a level from 50 to 99. A higher level will produce larger jpg files. 90 is a good tradeoff

title: PNG compression level for standard screenshots
desc: Set a level from 0 to 9. 0 will produce larger files. 3 is a good level balancing size and processing.

title: Zero out original standard screenshots
desc: If on, will replace your just created original screenshot file with a 0 byte file to save space, following conversion to JPG

title: Convert high-res screenshot
desc: Converts your new screenshot. If combined with 'Zero out orignal' option this will help save disk space

title: JPG quality level for high-res screenshots
desc: Set a level from 50 to 99. A higher level will produce larger jpg files. 90 is a good tradeoff

title: PNG compression level for high-res screenshots
desc: Set a level from 0 to 9. 0 will produce larger files. 3 is a good level balancing size and processing.

title: Zero out original high-res screenshots
desc: If on, will replace your just created original screenshot file with a 0 byte file to save space, following conversion to JPG
